Generated by Nebius Integration Scout · 2026-11-02 · endpoint https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/

- pydantic_ai on daytona: tool call verified — PydanticAI round-trip succeeded: tool called and typed output returned

Conformance kit: 8 pass · 1 partial · 4 fail (chat.basic=FAIL, tools.choice_required=FAIL, tools.choice_named=FAIL, structured.json_schema=FAIL, streaming.text=PARTIAL)

| model | TTFT ms | tokens/s | prefix-cache hit (tokens) |

| moonshotai/Kimi-K3 | 1255.4 | 88.6 | 64 |
| Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 | 351.6 | 155.3 | 208 |

## Findings
- Kimi-K3 fails basic chat: returns empty content (chat.basic=FAIL)
- Tool calling works but choice control is broken (tools.choice_required=FAIL)
- JSON schema output fails with parse error (structured.json_schema=FAIL)
- Text streaming is partial: usage reported only on final chunk
- Kimi-K3 is 3.6x slower to first token than Qwen (1255ms vs 352ms)
- Qwen sustains 155 tokens/s vs Kimi-K3's 89 tokens/s

## Next steps
- Use Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 for production agent workloads
- File a support ticket for Kimi-K3's chat and JSON schema issues
- Retest Kimi-K3 after next model push
- Benchmark Kimi-K3 again when running longer agent traces
